name: TryAMM Global Mobility & Delivery Readiness

profitModel.rule: Do not activate an owned fleet solely because volume is high. Require positive modeled contribution after insurance, support, safety, taxes/fees, incentives and realistic idle time.

aiGuardrails: AI cannot declare a legal license unnecessary without jurisdiction-specific human/legal verification.
AI cannot approve insurance coverage, worker classification, or regulated launch by itself.
AI recommendations must store sources, dates, assumptions, reviewer and approval status.
Rules must be refreshed before each country/city launch and on renewal.
globalExpansionOrder: launch with licensed/approved partners where possible
add local contracted courier or fleet partners
pursue own permits/licenses only where economics justify it
expand only after safety, support and profitability KPIs pass
